title: Humans Spot Only 55% Of Deepfake Videos
hook: Seeing a video is no longer strong proof.
closing: Verification now matters because convincing video can be both fake and expensive.
question: Could you spot a deepfake?

segments.say: Deepfake videos reached 95,820 online, turning a niche trick into mass-produced deception.
People identify deepfakes correctly only 55 percent of the time, so seeing a video is weak proof.
Deepfake-enabled fraud losses reached 12.3 billion dollars, making verification a financial safeguard.
